svg.text: Live ops recipe library & adaptation rules
Choose an event recipe and a core-game adapter. Keep eligibility, deadlines and settlement explicit.
Daily / weekly quests
Normal gameplay actions → capped objectives → immediate claims. Segment tasks by unlocked
mechanics; server-time reset; do not assign unavailable content.
Solo milestone / collection
Earn event points → reach thresholds → claim earned items. Show all milestones, point sources,
limits and grace period. Convert leftover tokens by a stated rule.
Leaderboard / tournament
Enroll → cohort → qualifying / final rounds → verified results → rank payout. Publish tie-breaks,
level caps, accepted-match cutoff and results delay.
Club / alliance cooperation
Roster eligibility → individual contribution → team goal → shared reward. Explain joining/leaving,
minimum contribution, roster lock and inactive members.
Season pass
Earn XP through play → free and premium tracks → tier claims → rollover. Show retroactive rewards,
season end and unclaimed entitlement policy.
Limited-time challenge
Alternate rules → limited attempts or tickets → outcome → reward. Preview entry cost,
retry/abandon rules and any level normalization before commitment.
Token exchange / event shop
Earn currency → preview item → confirm exchange → grant. Define stock, limits, conversion and
expiry separately from the event play window.
Returner / catch-up
Inactivity qualification → concise recap → familiar win → catch-up mission. Cap prompts; protect
existing progress; avoid replaying the full new-user lesson.
Surface arbitration / one clear next action
PRIORITY & FREQUENCY
Critical service/account message → resumed FTUE → earned reward → requested destination → relevant
event → optional offer. Suppress marketing during gameplay, FTUE and active recovery. Dedupe by
message ID; cap per session/day.
DEEP LINKS & TIME
Resolve destination after save and eligibility checks. Active → event detail. Locked → requirement.
Ended → results/claim. Expired → archive or hub. Store deadlines in UTC, display localized times and
relative countdowns from server time.
Example cadence / adapt after measuring player load
DAILY
Free gift + small quests + rotating feature slot. Avoid
overlapping forced prompts. One useful return reason is
enough.
WEEKLY
Alternate a solo milestone with a club or competitive event.
Leave room for regular progression and catch-up.
SEASONAL
Season track + thematic event + recap/settlement. Example
duration 28 days; choose actual timing from game data.
Genre adapters / replace the action and its lifecycle
Card duel / Clash Royale pattern
Deck slots → valid-cost check → duel → trophies → reward queue → collection upgrades. Add chest full / unlock timer / claim states only if used.
Hero action / Brawl Stars pattern
Hero + role → party + mode → map rules → short round → mastery → quests / season XP. Define team readiness, reconnect and competitive caps.
Settlement / Kingshot pattern
Building → requirements → assign worker → start job → timer → alliance help / confirmed speedup → collect → unlock. Add busy queue, canceled job and refund rules.
Puzzle / Candy Crush pattern
Level → goal + pre-boosters → moves board → win or fail → confirm extra moves / retry → lives refill → map. Show partial goal state and no-fill ad handling.
Sports / Tennis Clash pattern
Tour → entry fee + caps → gear → matchmaking → points → result → bag slots / timer → upgrade. Add qualifying / final rounds and authoritative payout.
Configure balance, content, regulations, cohorts and audience policy per game. No sample amount is a recommended production value.
